caption:
Every satellite India launches needs a processor that can survive space. Until last year, none of them were built entirely in India.

ISRO's Semiconductor Laboratory built the Vikram 3201 - India's first fully indigenous space-grade processor, unveiled in September 2025. It's built to keep working across a 180-degree temperature swing, from -55°C to +125°C.

Before this, India's space program depended on foreign-made processors for the same job. ISRO has now set a four-year target to manufacture space-grade semiconductors domestically at scale, backed by the ₹76,000 crore Semicon India Mission.

A rocket is only as independent as the chip flying inside it - this is the part of the space program most people never see, and the part that decides whether the rest of it can be built without asking anyone else first.

Sources: Business Standard, The Week (2026)
